case_title: Bipolar I Disorder, Acute Manic Episode with Psychosis

ehr_notes.admission_hp:
ADMISSION H&P:
PATIENT: Synthetic Patient A (DOB: 05/12/1988)
DATE OF ADMISSION: 10/01/2026
LEGAL STATUS: Involuntary 5150 72-hour hold for grave disability.
HPI: 38yo male with Bipolar I disorder admitted after 5 nights of total insomnia, hyperverbal speech, and grandiose delusions of founding three biotech companies overnight. Flushed baseline lithium carbonate 10 days prior.
ADMISSION LABS: Lithium level < 0.2 mEq/L, CBC normal, BMP normal, UDS negative.
ADMISSION MEDS STARTED: Lithium carbonate 600 mg PO BID, Olanzapine 10 mg PO QHS, Lorazepam 1 mg PO TID PRN severe agitation.
ehr_notes.interval_progress:
INTERVAL PROGRESS NOTES:
DAY 2 (10/03/2026): Patient calmer, slept 7 hours. No PRN lorazepam required in past 24 hours. Lithium 600 mg BID continued.
DAY 4 (10/05/2026): 5150 expired; patient signed voluntary admission agreement. Lithium trough level 0.8 mEq/L (therapeutic range 0.6-1.2 mEq/L). Olanzapine reduced to 5 mg PO QHS due to morning sedation.
ehr_notes.discharge_plan:
DISCHARGE PLAN (10/08/2026):
DISCHARGE MEDICATIONS:
1. Lithium carbonate 600 mg PO BID (30-day supply, #60)
2. Olanzapine 5 mg PO QHS (30-day supply, #30)
NOTE: Lorazepam PRN was discontinued on Day 3 and is NOT prescribed at discharge.
FOLLOW-UP: Outpatient psychiatry clinic appointment on 10/15/2026 at 10:00 AM. Repeat BMP and lithium level on 10/22/2026.

ehr_notes.admission_hp:
ADMISSION H&P:
PATIENT: Synthetic Patient B (DOB: 11/24/1992)
DATE OF ADMISSION: 09/15/2026
LEGAL STATUS: Voluntary admission.
HPI: 33yo female with treatment-resistant schizoaffective disorder, bipolar type, failing prior adequate trials of risperidone and aripiprazole. Admitted for monitored clozapine initiation.
BASELINE LABS: Absolute Neutrophil Count (ANC) 3,400 /mcL (normal >= 1,500), Troponin negative, ECG QTc 418 ms.
ehr_notes.interval_progress:
INTERVAL PROGRESS NOTES:
DAY 7 (09/22/2026): Clozapine titrated to 100 mg PO QHS. Weekly CBC/ANC: ANC 2,800 /mcL.
DAY 14 (09/29/2026): Clozapine increased to 150 mg PO QHS. Weekly CBC/ANC: ANC 2,400 /mcL. Vitals stable, temp 98.4 F, resting heart rate 82 bpm.
ehr_notes.discharge_plan:
DISCHARGE PLAN (10/06/2026):
DISCHARGE MEDICATIONS:
1. Clozapine 150 mg PO QHS (7-day supply only, REMS registry requirement)
FOLLOW-UP: Mandatory weekly ANC draw on 10/13/2026 before pharmacy can dispense next 7-day supply. Outpatient visit 10/14/2026.

case_title: Severe Major Depressive Disorder with Suicidal Ideation

ehr_notes.admission_hp:
ADMISSION H&P:
PATIENT: Synthetic Patient C (DOB: 03/18/1999)
DATE OF ADMISSION: 10/10/2026
LEGAL STATUS: Involuntary 5150 hold for danger to self.
HPI: 27yo female presenting with severe unipolar major depression, psychomotor retardation, and active suicidal ideation with a plan. No prior manic or hypomanic episodes.
ADMISSION MEDS: Started Sertraline 50 mg PO daily, titrated to 100 mg PO daily on Day 4. Hydroxyzine 25 mg PO TID PRN anxiety.
ehr_notes.interval_progress:
INTERVAL PROGRESS NOTES:
DAY 3 (10/13/2026): Patient denies active suicidal ideation, contract for safety established. 5150 hold discontinued by attending psychiatrist; voluntary status maintained.
DAY 5 (10/15/2026): Sertraline 100 mg daily tolerated well. Patient completed safety plan with social work.
ehr_notes.discharge_plan:
DISCHARGE PLAN (10/18/2026):
DISCHARGE MEDICATIONS:
1. Sertraline 100 mg PO daily (#30)
NOTE: Hydroxyzine PRN was discontinued prior to discharge.
FOLLOW-UP: Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP) starting 10/20/2026 at 9:00 AM.
